gloss: early old age; past middle age

definitions.gloss: early old age; the threshold of old age; past middle age
definitions.explanation: The time of life when a person first starts to grow old. Traditionally it meant the age of forty; today it usually suggests someone in their late fifties or sixties. Mostly used in writing to describe a person's apparent age.

examples.japanese: {初老|しょろう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧。
examples.english: A man in early old age.

examples.japanese: ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{初老|しょろう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{座|すわ}っていた→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: An older couple, getting on in years, was sitting in the shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{初老|しょろう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{差|さ}し{掛|か}かり→差し掛かる：06735_sashikakaru⟧、⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→頃：32850_koro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できなく→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: He too is reaching the threshold of old age and can no longer push himself as he did when he was young.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always in the pattern {初老|しょろう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + person ({初老|しょろう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紳士|しんし}→紳士：18022_shinshi⟧, {初老|しょろう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧), as in novels and news reports describing someone. Calling a person {初老|しょろう} to their face can sound blunt.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初老|しょろう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧ / ⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧: an older man / woman
- {初老|しょろう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{差|さ}し{掛|か}かる→差し掛かる：06735_sashikakaru⟧: to reach early old age
- {初老|しょろう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to enter early old age

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{中年|ちゅうねん}→中年：11307_chuunen⟧: middle age (roughly forties and fifties)
- ⟦{老年|ろうねん}→老年：14072_rounen⟧: old age
- ⟦{高齢|こうれい}→高齢：14648_kourei⟧: advanced age (the neutral, official word)
